_comment: Section VI: layout optimization through the network (VI-C) and the single-board extensions of Table tab:single (VI-E). The convergence of the losses (VI-D) uses the training histories of base, nophys and physExt (no extra run). Single-board runs call src/py/main.py (PF mode, board of the PF tutorial) with the parameters of config/other/FR4 and the overrides below; results: <out>/single.json
name: journal_pinn_Sec_VI
section: VI-C Layout Optimization, VI-E Single-Board Extensions

single._help: dl: training of the PF mode; operator: operator network (Mdl > pinf, selPF = 1); coordinate: coordinate PINN (selPF = 2); pinf.phys: 0 data only, 1 strong form (automatic differentiation), 2 FV residual, 3 FV residual with learned factors s_k, s_h; nSens: number of sensors (0: all nodes)

steps._help: gradient descent on the chip centres through the network physAll, FV check, FV random search over 100 layouts
